label: Garland multi-mode passive fibre TAP 1/10/25G (OM4501)
description: Garland OM4501 passive multimode fibre TAP - one tap, 50/50 split, 850 nm over OM3/OM4 LC multimode fibre, carrying 1G/10G/25G through unpowered with copies on two monitor ports. Stainless-steel tube package, no power source, no IP or MAC address.
notes: From the family model table on Garland's multimode passive TAP datasheet: OM4501 is **1/10/25G, one tap, 50/50, 850 nm, OM3/OM4, LC multimode** - the 25G sibling of the OM3501 already in this catalogue, and the reason the speed ladder goes to 25G rather than stopping at 10G. Four LC ports: two network, two monitor. No power is needed and none is accepted, so there is no `poeIn` to declare and nothing to configure: the split is optical, 50/50, with 60/40, 80/20 and 90/10 available to order. Because the split is passive, A and B keep the live link up even if the monitoring tool is off or unplugged.
